SteamCMD (steamcmd.exe) is bundled with the installer as Valve's unmodified bootstrap.

Source: https://media.steampowered.com/client/installer/steamcmd.zip
Copyright (C) Valve Corporation. SteamCMD is distributed by Valve under the
Steam Subscriber Agreement and the SteamCMD documentation; it is not covered
by this project's MIT license.

SteamCMD is used only to read public app_info output (+app_info_print).
On its first run SteamCMD downloads its own binaries and updates itself, so
the bundled copy is a starting point rather than a fixed version.
